title: Epilogue
brief: Warm editorial illustration in the same palette as the article's cover: cream paper tones, terracotta orange accent, deep ink blue, soft night light. Scene: a small friendly robot with a simple round chat-avatar face (two dot eyes, one orange circle face like a messaging app contact) sits calmly on top of an open archive box packed with glowing paper folders and files; a small luggage tag hangs from the box; beside the box stands a rolled blueprint. Behind, a wooden shelf holds several other little robots with distinctly colored round faces (blue, purple, green, warm yellow), arranged in a tidy row like a contact roster in an address book. Thin warm light lines drift softly between the robots and the folders. Cozy, quiet, sophisticated editorial mood, clean composition with generous negative space. No text, no letters, no words, no logos.
